interpretation: The observed 72 synchronization/copy pairs per forward exactly match four metadata list conversions in each of 18 GDN layers. This is strong source/trace agreement, not a measured speedup from removing them. No framework source or head math was changed.
restoration: Diagnostic server stopped after captures. Replacement with EOS_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR unset, max_num_seqs=32 and max_num_batched_tokens=16384 returned HTTP 200 from /health. T2 continued on five other NPUs.
measurement_caveat: Use unprofiled diagnostic timings for host stage attribution and profiled kernel sums for device busy work. Do not add overlapping host and device durations; event intervals include host launch gaps.
